text: Given a mocked Partner Center response with 1 subscription, When csp_list_customer_subscriptions is called, Then items has 1 entry with id/offer_name/quantity/status/billing_cycle/unit_type/commitment_end_date matching the mocked response
Given a request to /mcp with no X-PartnerCenter-Token header, When any tool is called, Then the server returns 401 listing X-PartnerCenter-Token as a required header, and no upstream call is made
Given customer_tenant_id is omitted or blank, When csp_list_customer_subscriptions is called, Then invalid_argument is returned and the mocked client recorded zero calls
Given the mocked upstream returns 404, When called, Then not_found is returned with the upstream message
Given the mocked upstream returns 403, When called, Then unauthorized is returned with the upstream message
Given the mocked upstream returns {totalCount:0, items:[]}, When called, Then items is [], total_count is 0, has_more is false (success, not an error)
Given the mocked upstream returns 75 items and totalCount 75 with no limit passed, When called, Then exactly 50 items are returned and has_more is true
Given two concurrent calls with different tokens and customer_tenant_id values, When both run concurrently, Then each mocked upstream request carries only its own call's token and tenant id
Given the mocked upstream returns 503 on every attempt, When called, Then upstream_error is returned with retryable true, after the configured retries are exhausted
